evidence.observation: Title screen; a confirm press starts the attempt and the HUD timer begins counting.
evidence.riff: Started through the real menu action, not by calling start_session().

evidence.observation: Holding right accelerates the character to a constant walk speed across Ground A.
evidence.riff: One speed, reached in about eight ticks; there is no run button to learn.

evidence.observation: A single press lifts the character onto the step block; height does not vary with how long the key is held.
evidence.riff: One fixed arc is the whole movement vocabulary, which is what makes the later slot a precision problem rather than a power problem.

evidence.observation: The character clears the original spike cluster at x 320 with a jump.
evidence.riff: The one hazard the starter shipped with, and the one the drawing literals happened to match.

evidence.observation: The 64 px gap at x 448 and the 48 px gap at x 736 are both cleared at full speed.
evidence.riff: Both original gaps sit under 60% of the reachable distance; nothing in the starter tests the limit.

evidence.observation: Thrusters fire while the character is off the ground and stop on landing; the flame is visibly longer while rising than after the apex.
evidence.riff: Measured from this take: 6.7 logical px rising against 3.3 px falling. The starter had no airborne drawing at all.

evidence.observation: Landing on the chevron pad launches the character far higher than a jump and onto the observation deck.
evidence.riff: A separate constant, -480 against the jump's -320, applied only on pad contact; the jump is unchanged everywhere else.

evidence.observation: The platform is solid, blinks for the last half second, disappears leaving a faint outline, and returns. Three full cycles pass while the route stands on the deck, then it commits and lands.
evidence.riff: The blink is the whole design: without it a vanishing platform reads as the game cheating rather than as a rhythm you were shown.

evidence.observation: The route jumps while the platform is absent, falls past the kill line, and the game returns it to the spawn point to run again. Retry counter increments.
evidence.riff: The miss is the driver's decision; the death is the game's own physics. Cheap retry is the point of the slice.

evidence.observation: The character hops from the strip over the first spike cluster and lands in the 40 px gap between the clusters.
evidence.riff: A full-speed jump overshoots the slot from anywhere standable, so the arc has to be shortened in mid-air. That is the skill the section actually tests.

evidence.observation: Reaching the goal area ends the attempt and shows the completion panel with elapsed time, retry count and a replay prompt.
evidence.riff: The goal is 56 px tall and a jump is 56 px, so the completion is touched in mid-air rather than on landing.
